hooks.name: voice-check
hooks.description: Wording rules are judgement calls, so an agent checks them against steering/voice.md after user-facing text changes.

action.prompt: A file with user-facing wording was just saved. Read .kiro/steering/voice.md, then check only the lines that changed in that file. Report any line that (1) blames the user, (2) sounds like an AI disclaimer, (3) claims understanding, or (4) states a cause without hedging. Quote the line and give a replacement. If nothing breaks the rules, say so in one sentence and do not edit anything.
